description: Defines interfaces for Orleans grains related to dependency injection and testing, including methods for retrieving values and verifying service resolutions.

methods.name: GetLongValue
methods.description: Asynchronous method to retrieve a long value.

methods.name: GetStringValue
methods.description: Asynchronous method to retrieve a string value.
